key_points: UBS upgrade and Q2 2026 earnings beat provide a positive fundamental backdrop, though the stock edged lower suggesting partial prior pricing or merger-related caution
Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern merger remains the dominant thesis driver, creating both strategic upside and significant regulatory/integration risk
CNI CEO commentary confirming growth plans tied to the Union Pacific deal signals competitors are taking the merger seriously as a market-shaping event
Upcoming conference update flagged as a potential catalyst for re-rating
Minor 1.1% pullback is noise; the key variable over weeks is merger regulatory progress and conference guidance
